hero.heading: Hello, I am Nguyen Minh Dat
hero.description: Welcome to my portfolio! Here you'll find my projects, skills, and experiences in the field of information technology.

about.description1: I'm a Software Engineering graduate with a passion for technology and solving real-world problems. I enjoy learning new things, taking on challenges, and continuously improving both my technical and professional skills.
about.description2: Throughout my academic projects and internship experience, I have worked on software development, business analysis, and team collaboration. These experiences have strengthened my analytical thinking, communication, and problem-solving abilities.
about.description3: I'm always eager to explore new technologies, expand my knowledge, and contribute to meaningful projects that create value for users and businesses.

projects.description1: A modern restaurant platform with authentication, ordering food, checkout process, order management, and VNPay integration.
projects.description2: Weather App is a modern weather forecasting application built with Next.js and TypeScript. It provides real-time weather conditions, hourly forecasts, and a 7-day forecast with a clean and responsive user interface.
projects.description3: A role-based school management platform for students, teachers, parents, and administrators. Includes authentication, attendance tracking, grade management, and dashboard analytics.
projects.description4: A modern veterinary hospital website that provides pet care information, online appointment booking, service management, and user-friendly experience for pet owners and hospital staffs.
